rows_walked.E.competitions.cron-bounded: FAILED, then FIXED. TournamentService::resolve_expired_matches() ran two queries with NO LIMIT and no ORDER BY while its four siblings were all capped at 50. Proven at runtime both directions: unbounded processed all 120 seeded matches in one tick; bounded processes 50 and drains (120 -> 70 -> 20). Fixed in Pro, CRON_BATCH_SIZE=50.

found_and_fixed_during_walk: PHP Warning: Undefined variable $mvs_filter_tag / $mvs_filter_cat in templates/explore.php:402-403 on EVERY profile route (/media/@user/). Assigned inside `if ( ! $mvs_profile )` but read unconditionally. Fixed by hoisting the initialisation above the branch; re-walked to 0 warnings. This is why the report shows debug_log_issues: [] - the warning is fixed in the code being packaged, not omitted.

Runbook A1 acceptance was wrong in two ways and would have failed a correct install: it said 21 tables (actual 23) and that mvs_db_version equals MVS_VERSION (it is a schema integer, 30). Corrected in AGENT_SMOKE_RUNBOOK.md.

TournamentService::resolve_expired_matches() ran two UNBOUNDED cron queries and resolved every expired match in a single tick, each resolution advancing a bracket and notifying players. A timeout part-way through would leave brackets half-advanced with no signal. Now capped at 50 like its four siblings; mutation-proven both directions.

Uploads pushed to cloud on the request path: 11,719 ms and 6 blocking round trips per image, so five photos took about a minute and looked stuck. Now local-first with an Action Scheduler job; 218 ms per image.

Activity composer uploaded files strictly sequentially and mvs-rest.js had NO timeout anywhere, so one stalled request hung the UI forever with no error. Now 3 at a time with order preserved, and every fetch is bounded.

Activity photo grids declared three fixed rows on phones, leaving 160px of blank space under 3- and 4-photo posts, and 2-photo posts kept the desktop 280px row and cropped landscapes to a third of their width (Basecamp 10253855410).
